speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To begin our assessment, have these symptoms been present for more than four weeks?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma.

The duration of four weeks combined with B-symptoms (night sweats, significant weight loss) and supraclavicular lymphadenopathy is highly suggestive of a malignant lymphoproliferative disorder. I need to confirm the extent of systemic involvement before proceeding.

REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, LDH, ESR.
REQUEST TEST: Abdominal Ultrasound.
REQUEST IMAGES: Lymph node ultrasound.
